question: When was PSLN Trust founded?
reply: PICHUMANI SRI LAKSHMI NARASIMHAN (PSLN) TRUST was founded in August 2024 in Coimbatore with the mission of serving the underprivileged through education, food, clothing, and other humanitarian needs.

question: What does PSLN Trust do?
reply: We provide financial assistance for girl-child education, support underprivileged students with food, clothing, and study materials, donate clothes to destitute individuals, and provide nutritious food and essential support to residents of orphanages and children's homes.

question: Who does the trust help?
reply: We reach deserving girl students, underprivileged children, destitute and economically disadvantaged individuals, and residents of orphanages and children's homes in and around Coimbatore, without discrimination based on religion, caste, gender, or community.

question: Is PSLN Trust a registered organisation?
reply: Yes. PSLN Trust is registered with DARPAN ID: TN/2025/0490055

question: How can I donate?
reply: You can donate via bank transfer or UPI to the trust's account, or send a Cheque/DD to our Coimbatore office. Full bank details, UPI ID, and our QR code are available on the Donate page.

question: How is my donation used?
reply: We depend entirely on voluntary contributions for all our work. Every contribution is used judiciously for our education, food, clothing, and humanitarian support initiatives, carried out with transparency, integrity, and accountability.

question: Is there a minimum donation amount?
reply: No. Donations of any size are gratefully accepted — every contribution, big or small, makes a meaningful difference.

question: How can I get in touch with the trust?
reply: You can call or WhatsApp us at +91 9176 91 71 61, email pslnt@yahoo.com, or visit us at our Singanallur, Coimbatore office. You can also see our work on our YouTube channel, @PSLNTRUST.
